font.family.description: Primary font family name used for terminal text rendering.

font.line_height.description: Line height multiplier relative to font size (1.0..=2.0).

font.fallback.description: User-ordered fallback font family names tried before platform defaults.

font.features.description: Raw OpenType feature overrides applied at shaping time (e.g. 'calt', 'zero', 'ss01').

window.padding.description: Inner window padding in logical pixels (0..=64).

window.radius_px.description: Window corner radius in physical pixels (0..=24).

window.blur_radius.description: Background blur radius in logical pixels (0..=128; platform support varies).

window.background_image.description: Window background image path (absolute or ~-anchored, <= 4096 bytes, approved roots).

window.background_fit.description: Window background fit mode (fill, fit, center, tile, stretch; default fill).

window.background_opacity.description: Window background image dim factor (0.0..=1.0, default 1.0).

window.background_position.description: Window background position for fit/center letterbox (default center).

decoration.border.description: View frame border width in logical pixels (0..=32, default 1).

decoration.radius.description: View frame corner radius in logical pixels (0..=64, default 6).

decoration.gaps_in.description: Inner gap between sibling panels in logical pixels (0..=128, default 6).

decoration.gaps_out.description: Outer gap around the workspace container in logical pixels (0..=128, default 6).

decoration.content_inset.description: Inner padding between border and painted content in logical pixels (0..=128, default 6).

decoration.border_color.description: Base outline border color in hex (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).

decoration.border_color_focused.description: Explicit outline color for focused view in hex (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).

decoration.border_color_idle.description: Explicit outline color for unfocused/idle views in hex (#RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA).

decoration.border_width.description: Base outline width in logical pixels (0..=32, default 1).

decoration.border_width_focused.description: Explicit outline width for focused view in logical pixels (0..=32).

decoration.border_width_idle.description: Explicit outline width for idle views in logical pixels (0..=32).

decoration.background_image.description: Global default background image path under approved roots.

decoration.background_image_roots.description: Approved directory path roots for background images.

terminal.scroll_lines_per_notch.description: Lines scrolled per wheel notch (1..=32, default 3).

terminal.scroll_pixels_per_notch.description: Smooth-scroll pixels per wheel notch (1..=256, default 16).

selection.auto_copy.description: Whether selecting text automatically copies to the system clipboard (default false).

layout.gaps_in.description: Inner gap between sibling panes in character cells (default 0).

layout.gaps_out.description: Outer gap between container edges and panes in character cells (default 0).

layout.resize_step.description: Tiled split-ratio delta per resize keypress (0.01..=0.5, default 0.05).

appearance.theme.description: Built-in theme name (e.g. catppuccin-mocha, tokyo-night, gruvbox-dark).

appearance.colors.description: Custom color palette definition (background, foreground, cursor, selection, and 16 ANSI colors).

mod_key.description: Modifier key for shipped chrome keymaps ('alt' or 'super').

leader_timeout_ms.description: Timeout in milliseconds before an incomplete leader chord cancels (100..=60000, default 1000).

input.leader.description: Canonical Leader chord string (e.g. 'ctrl+b', wins over leader_key).

input.timeout_len.description: Canonical Leader pending-window timeout in milliseconds (100..=60000, default 1000).

hints_enabled.description: Whether interactive chord hint overlays are enabled.

keymaps.description: User keybinding overrides and chord registrations ({ chord, action, context }).

workspace.show_bar.description: Whether the workspace status bar is displayed.

workspace.bar.edge.description: Edge placement of the workspace status bar ('top' or 'bottom').

workspace.layout.description: Default layout provider name for new workspaces (e.g. 'bsp', 'dwindle').

mouse.focus_follows_mouse.description: Whether pane focus follows cursor movement.

mouse.focus_follows_mouse_delay_ms.description: Dwell time in milliseconds before focus follows mouse switches pane.

session.restore_on_startup.description: Whether to restore previous workspaces and session on startup.
